message.content: We must understand that the pharaoh’s power relied heavily on trade. They controlled the flow of goods, and this gave them immense influence. If you look at their records, you will see they taxed merchants strictly. The priests supported the king because he provided stability. We know that gold came from Nubia, and it enriched the state. They built temples with those riches, and the people respected them for it. You cannot ignore how vital these routes were to their survival. It is clear that without trade, the empire would have collapsed quickly. Their scribes documented every transaction carefully, ensuring no one cheated the crown. We should appreciate the complexity of their system today.
